items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.summary: Anthropic has warned that its AI is nearing Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) capabilities. This threshold marks a point where AI models can train themselves, potentially leading to rapid and uncontrollable advancements.
items.blurb: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

items.title: Apple set an iPhone sales record even without a new standard iPhone
items.summary: Apple reported record-breaking revenue for the iPhone, reaching $57.58 billion in the fourth quarter. This represents a 17 percent increase compared to the previous year, despite the absence of a new standard model release.
items.blurb: Apple had a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales - despite not releasing a standard model during its latest refresh. In its fourth-quarter earnings report released on Monday, Apple says it earned $57.58 billion in iPhone revenue, a 17 percent jump from the same time last year. items.title: Meta will end Quest 2 OS updates in 2027
items.summary: Meta plans to discontinue OS updates for its Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027. Following the final update, v213, the company will only provide critical security patches and bug fixes.
items.blurb: Meta is planning to release the last OS update for its Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027, the company announced today. The last OS update for those devices is planned to be v213, and after that, Meta will continue to ship security patches and critical bug fixes through the end of […]

items.title: One of Google’s Android partners turned 1.3 million set-top boxes into a botnet
items.summary: Google discovered that an Android hardware partner, Videostrong Technology, embedded a backdoor into 1.3 million devices to create a botnet. Google has since removed the backdoor and terminated its relationship with the manufacturer.
items.blurb: Google says one of its Android manufacturing partners secretly built a backdoor in 1.3 million devices and turned them into a botnet. The company says it has now dismantled the backdoor and "cut ties" with the manufacturer, the Shenzhen, China-based Videostrong Technology Co., which has been banned from building or selling certified Android devices or […]

items.title: BMW is taking on Tesla’s FSD with urban driver assist starting in 2027
items.summary: BMW plans to launch urban driver assistance features starting in 2027, initially rolling out in Germany. This system aims to provide steering and speed control on both highways and city streets using GPS navigation.
items.blurb: BMW says that it will expand its navigation-guided, partially automated driving capabilities into urban environments starting in 2027, launching first in Germany with other markets to follow. The new system can help steer, speed up, and slow down the vehicle on both highways and city streets using its built-in GPS navigation. While driving in town, […]

items.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
items.summary: Apple has issued warnings to several German lawmakers and a filmmaker indicating their iPhones may have been targeted by spyware. The notifications highlight security concerns regarding potential unauthorized access to their devices.
items.blurb: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

items.title: Casio's new keyboard lets anyone play along to songs without ever hitting a wrong note
items.summary: Casio has introduced Feel Sync technology for its new keyboards. This feature is designed to assist players in staying in tune while playing along to songs.
items.blurb: Casio's new Feel Sync technology helps keep new players in tune.

items.title: Your Apple AirPods' chirping noise doesn't just mean low battery
items.summary: Apple AirPods may emit a chirping sound for reasons beyond a low battery state. Users can learn the causes of these alerts and how to disable them.
items.blurb: Learn why your Apple AirPods are making a noise - and how to turn the sound off.

items.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
items.summary: Website builder Squarespace has announced it is laying off 19 percent of its workforce. The company stated that the cuts are part of a broader organizational restructuring.
items.blurb: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

items.title: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is $100 off, matching its best price to date
items.summary: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is currently available for $699.99, which is $100 off its regular price. This discount matches the lowest price ever recorded for the device at Amazon.
items.blurb: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is the company’s most capable smartwatch. Whether you intend to put its many tracking features to the test, or you simply want the longest battery life of any Apple Watch, it’s currently on sale for $699.99 ($100 off) in multiple colors at Amazon, matching its all-time low price. Powered by […]

items.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
items.summary: The New York Times has filed a lawsuit against the web browser company Brave. The suit alleges that Brave is scraping copyrighted content to distribute to its customers and third-party AI firms.
items.blurb: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

items.title: Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders
items.summary: Snap has reached a settlement in a lawsuit claiming its platform contributed to depression and eating disorders among teenagers. Plaintiffs alleged that features like infinite scrolling and autoplay fostered compulsive usage habits.
items.blurb: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.

items.title: Snap settles social media addiction lawsuit to avoid trial
items.summary: Snap has opted to settle a social media addiction lawsuit to avoid going to trial. The settlement comes after CEO Evan Spiegel was scheduled to provide testimony in the case.
items.blurb: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel was due to testify in the upcoming trial.

items.title: Ford promises not to sell your driving habits to data brokers
items.summary: Ford has pledged that it will not sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers. This move is intended to differentiate the company from competitors facing scrutiny over unauthorized telematics data sharing.
items.blurb: Ford vowed to never sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers as part of a new privacy promise aimed at setting the automaker apart from competitors that have faced legal and regulatory blowback for sharing telematics with data brokers without authorization. As part of its new promise, Ford says it will strive to protect […]

items.title: Why some websites are blocking AI agents from accessing the web
items.summary: Websites are increasingly blocking AI agents from accessing their content. While these agents can automate purchases, their automated access can create technical and functional difficulties for site owners.
items.blurb: AI agents can be a great tool to help make purchases for you online - but it can become a frustrating problem if the website you're using blocks their access.

items.title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
items.summary: Anthropic is updating its Claude Code tool to prevent users from recreating existing video games. The change addresses the rise of AI-generated ports and decompilations in the retro gaming scene.
items.blurb: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to recreate existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware. Retro gaming is currently being overrun with AI-made decompilations, recompilations, and ports, but while Anthropic will still let people use Claude Code to make games, it doesn't want people to […]

items.title: Xbox’s former COO has ‘serious concerns’ about her abrupt departure
items.summary: Former Xbox COO Helen Chiang has expressed concerns regarding her sudden departure from Microsoft. Her exit occurred less than two weeks after a promotion and following a 21-year career at the company.
items.blurb: Xbox's former chief operating officer, Helen Chiang, suddenly left Microsoft less than two weeks ago after being promoted into the role in July. I wrote in my Notepad newsletter last week that it seemed very weird for Chiang to suddenly depart Microsoft after 21 years with a surprisingly short memo from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma. […]

items.title: Think twice before putting your gaming console inside a cabinet
items.summary: Placing gaming consoles inside cabinets can restrict necessary airflow. Users are warned that this lack of ventilation may prevent systems from running safely.
items.blurb: A cabinet might seem like a convenient spot for your console, but it can't provide enough airflow for the system to run safely.

items.title: SpaceX is reportedly looking at buying Boost Mobile or using its cell network
items.summary: SpaceX is reportedly exploring the possibility of acquiring Boost Mobile or utilizing its cellular network. A deal could provide SpaceX with a faster path to becoming a mobile carrier.
items.blurb: A potential deal with Boost Mobile could serve as a shortcut to establishing SpaceX as a mobile carrier.

items.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a pilot program to use data center power plants to support local energy needs during emergencies. The company plans to dedicate excess energy capacity to stabilize power grids for surrounding areas.
items.blurb: In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes.
